name: West Lake
kicker: The large lake in Tay Ho
summary: Walk the shore of the large lake north of the center. A shore fee was not published, and neither was a minute count from Hoan Kiem. Both are check on arrival. Tran Quoc Pagoda is a separate stop.
getThere: From Hoan Kiem. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: A pavilion on the shore of West Lake

hours: Check on arrival. No shore clock was published.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. A shore fee was not published.
